html:
The Athenian who made Athens a sea power. He fortified Piraeus, and in 483 BCE persuaded the Athenians to spend a new silver strike at Laurium on warships instead of sharing it out. Three years later those ships won at Salamis, where he drew the Persian fleet into the narrows.

He was ostracised around 471 BCE, fled, and ended his life as a governor for the Persian king he had beaten.
